display_information.name: Agent Relay
display_information.description: Ask your team's agents in Slack. Every thread gets its own agent.
display_information.long_description: Agent Relay connects this Slack workspace to your self-hosted Agent Relay. Mention the app in a channel (or message it directly, if enabled) and an agent picks up the thread: follow-ups in the same thread go to the same agent, which keeps its context, and several people can talk to it at once. The agents run in your own infrastructure; Slack only sees what they post back into the thread.
